site.name: Network
site.what: The account behind every site: one sign-in, themes, notifications, history and linked services.

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: stops accepting connections and closes idle keep-alive ones
shutdown.note: timers, pollers and relays are not stopped; the forced exit after 10 s ends them, and their work is kept in the database

resumes.what: the developer-app, profile and grant event outboxes (developer/event-relay.js, identity/profile-events.js) send what is unsent
the email queue is processed again every 2 minutes; the retired-owner module sweep runs 5 minutes after boot
the ecosystem registry polls every service's readiness and release again; deploy drift and library tags refresh
OpenVibe.Events redelivers the moderation, staff and module events it consumes that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies
blockers: chrome_cache/chrome_hits were renamed to frame_cache/frame_hits (2026-09-24): a release from before that starts with empty caches
tool_domains was rebuilt once to allow the mirror role: a release from before it does not know mirror rows

leases.none: no claims: one process owns network.db (better-sqlite3, single writer); a stream-live announcement is claimed per streamer with a cooldown and a daily cap in the same database
